ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows 'Sunlight' at the top with arrows pointing to a 'Maize plant' on the left and a 'Wheat plant' on the right. The maize plant leads to corn used for feeding a chicken, and the wheat plant leads to wheat flour; these later connect to chicken pizza. Reasoning: A producer is an organism, usually a green plant, that uses sunlight to make its own food. In the diagram, the maize plant receives sunlight and is a plant at the start of the food chain, so it is a producer.
